description: The District Medical Officer of Bo District needs a dual-axis chart to compare testing volume against positivity rates. Using the DHIS2 Data Visualizer app: (1) Create a new chart for 'Bo' district showing 'Malaria RDTs performed' (as bars/columns) and 'Malaria RDT positivity rate' (as a line) for the 'Last 12 months'. (2) Configure the chart so 'Malaria RDT positivity rate' uses a secondary vertical axis (Axis 2 / Right axis) to handle the different scales. (3) Save the visualization as a favorite named 'Bo Malaria Testing vs Positivity 2024'. (4) Download the chart as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Desktop/malaria_chart.png'. Login credentials: admin / district.
